states.name: California
fun_facts: California has the largest economy of any U.S. state.
The highest and lowest points in the continental U.S. are both in California.
California produces more than half of all the fruits, vegetables, and nuts grown in the United States.

states.name: Texas
fun_facts: Texas is the second largest state by both area and population.
Texas was an independent country called the Republic of Texas from 1836 to 1845.
The King Ranch in Texas is bigger than the state of Rhode Island.

states.name: New York
fun_facts: New York City is the largest city in the United States.
The Statue of Liberty was a gift from France in 1886.
New York was one of the original 13 colonies.

states.name: Florida
fun_facts: Florida has the longest coastline in the contiguous United States.
St. Augustine, Florida is the oldest continuously occupied European settlement in the U.S.
Florida is the only state that borders both the Gulf of Mexico and the Atlantic Ocean.

states.name: Arizona
fun_facts: The Grand Canyon is one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World.
Arizona receives over 300 days of sunshine per year.
The saguaro cactus only grows in the Sonoran Desert of Arizona and Mexico.

states.name: Washington
fun_facts: Washington is the only state named after a U.S. president.
Seattle is home to the first Starbucks coffee shop.
Washington produces more apples than any other state.

states.name: Colorado
fun_facts: Colorado has more mountains over 14,000 feet than any other state.
The U.S. Air Force Academy is located in Colorado Springs.
Colorado's nickname comes from becoming a state in 1876, the centennial of the Declaration of Independence.

states.name: Illinois
fun_facts: Chicago is the third largest city in the United States.
Abraham Lincoln lived in Illinois before becoming president.
The world's first skyscraper was built in Chicago in 1885.

states.name: Georgia
fun_facts: Georgia is the largest state east of the Mississippi River.
Coca-Cola was invented in Atlanta in 1886.
Georgia was one of the original 13 colonies.

states.name: Ohio
fun_facts: Ohio is called the 'Mother of Presidents' because eight U.S. presidents were born there.
The first professional baseball team, the Cincinnati Red Stockings, was from Ohio.
The Wright Brothers, who invented the airplane, were from Dayton, Ohio.
